description: A CANDLE event with every required field of 2.1 except msg_seq (open_time_ms, open, recv_ms, raw_b64 and a matching sha256 are all valid): BAD_EVENT at its line, and no valid CANDLE exists (`candles` is {}). THIS VECTOR SAYS NOTHING ABOUT THE CANDLE RULES 6.2 TO 6.9 and does not ask a verifier to implement them: no vector of this package contains a VALID CANDLE event, and a verifier that lacks the CANDLE rules must give no verdict for a journal that has one (case 26). The r5 verifier has no msg_seq and sees a valid CANDLE here: the r6 finding is r6-only.
title: a CANDLE event without msg_seq is BAD_EVENT
